turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I made a vegetable soup from scratch, Denise's recipe, and it tasted almost right.
What went through your mind then?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. Yes, it was like that.
Tell me more about that.
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
Take your time.
Joy helped me write a formal complaint to the hospital about the missed diagnosis.
Take your time.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. That is how it was.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
What went through your mind then?
Walter and I now walk along the canal every Thursday morning.
Tell me more about that.
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Tell me more about that.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
What happened next?
At the food bank I met a woman named Gloria who also lost her husband to cancer.
How did that feel for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I think so, yes.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
